title: Ceiling Layout Drawing Checklist
scope: Ceiling layout drawings; use Not applicable for conditions absent from a particular drawing.

items.title: Identity and handedness
items.guidance: Confirm the cabin type and ALMACO code against the current Cabin Typing List. Show only handedness variants that actually exist; check the identification table on every sheet.
items.example_from_review: The comments identify an incorrect right-handed row for a cabin type with no right-handed version.

items.title: Drawing identity
items.guidance: Check the drawing number, name, revision, sheet count and related wall/ceiling drawing identifiers. Do not release a sheet with an unassigned drawing number or an ambiguous name.
items.example_from_review: A layout was marked as missing its drawing number; another comment asks for accurate naming.

items.title: Configuration and properties
items.guidance: Compare the drawing's configuration name, displayed dimensions, material or fire classification and referenced model/design-table properties. Resolve differences before release.
items.example_from_review: The comments flag a configuration/dimension mismatch and a B-15 property that should be checked in the design table.

items.title: Variant completeness
items.guidance: Compare left- and right-handed sheets where both variants exist. Check mirrored cutout positions and required dimensions; omit a nonexistent variant.
items.example_from_review: The comments identify cutouts in the wrong corner, missing dimensions in the opposite variant, and an invalid right-handed variant.

items.title: Panel and parts list
items.guidance: Match panel IDs, configuration/type codes, quantities and descriptions between views, balloons and the parts list. Include a part-number column where the list needs one; keep one clear balloon per part.
items.example_from_review: The review requests a part-number column, checks S/SM/SF markings, and asks for one balloon per part.

items.title: Dimension references
items.guidance: Dimension each panel, opening and profile from the intended manufacturing or installation datum. Prefer the ceiling panel edge when that is the controlling edge; make the reference unambiguous.
items.example_from_review: Comments correct dimensions taken from the inside of a profile or wall panel instead of the ceiling panel edge.

items.title: Dimensions and precision
items.guidance: Check that critical overall, cutout and detail dimensions are present, legible and rounded only to appropriate precision. Add center marks and matching dimensions on corresponding variants.
items.example_from_review: The review flags incorrect precision, missing center marks and an undimensioned cutout.

items.title: Profile and joint lengths
items.guidance: Check actual cut lengths for ceiling/decorative profiles, inclined frame sections and joint-filling pieces against the model and callouts. Distinguish different lengths where the profiles do not match.
items.example_from_review: A comment distinguishes inclined profile lengths; another changes a 938 mm note to the 926 mm joint-filling length in that instance.

items.title: Equipment openings
items.guidance: For each selected light, speaker, HVAC, sprinkler and detector, verify opening size, quantity and position against the selected component. Remove TBD values once equipment is fixed.
items.example_from_review: A selected speaker's required 172 mm opening was noted; the review also calls for opening quantity, size and placement.

items.title: Cable penetrations
items.guidance: Agree cable penetration sizes, quantities and positions with the electrical team and its current penetration drawing. If a cut is made on site, still specify its location and required size; remove temporary notes when final.
items.example_from_review: The comments ask for electrical coordination, verified cable positions and removal of a provisional note after finalization.

items.title: Installation direction
items.guidance: Show the installation start point and sequence clearly enough for the installer to follow, including direction changes around the cabin. Check that the note and arrow agree with the layout.
items.example_from_review: The start-point note was called unclear about the route toward the back of the cabin and door.

items.title: Materials and finish
items.guidance: Specify finish/color and the type and quantity of insulation or wool needed for procurement. Check joint filling and fire-related material callouts against the selected specification.
items.example_from_review: The review asks for wool type and quantity and questions a fire-related B-15 property; drawing callouts contain finish and joint-filling notes.

items.title: Annotations and readability
items.guidance: Scan each sheet at ordinary viewing scale: align leaders and arrowheads, separate crowded arrows, keep details large enough, avoid repeated notes, and use consistent circular balloons.
items.example_from_review: The comments request clearer detail boundaries, consistent arrowheads, round balloons and less crowded or repeated annotations.
